_note: Claude Code reports a run's dollars only at its end (result.total_cost_usd), so the gateway relay prices a running pass's per-message usage from this table (live-spend.mjs). USD per million tokens, Anthropic first-party rates as listed on `date`. `cacheRead` is the listed cache-read rate; `write5m` and `write1h` are the standard 1.25x and 2x of `input` for 5-minute and 1-hour cache writes. A model matches by its exact id or as that id plus a dated suffix; any other model is priced at `upperBound`, the dearest row, so the live estimate never runs low.
source: Anthropic model pricing (Claude API skill's current-models table, cached 2026-11-03)
